dimension_justifications.soundness: The finite-pool estimand and causal/resource boundaries are mostly careful, and the printed effect calculations and exact McNemar p-values are internally consistent. However, every central empirical record is absent, the fixed-realization estimand does not supply a probability model for the reported confidence intervals and tests, and the scorer and call-accounting definitions are not independently operational. The central evidence therefore cannot presently support the empirical claims.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The endpoint hierarchy, contrast orientations, limitations, and visual layout are unusually clear. Evaluation is nevertheless obstructed by incomplete operational definitions, omission of anti_inject results despite advertising a five-arm audit, and absent multiplicity details.
dimension_justifications.contribution: A bounded audit showing that scoring protocols may change multiple-choice accuracy could be useful, but the scope is one checkpoint, one constructed task bed, and recorded stochastic realizations. With no verifiable experimental artifacts, the independently checkable contribution is primarily the estimand and evidence-boundary framing rather than a validated empirical finding.

paper_summary: The paper compares five complete multiple-choice scoring protocols for LLaDA-8B-Instruct on constructed four-choice GSM8K pools. Its source-designated primary result reports a 13.0 percentage-point advantage of s_conf over mc_uniform on n=400, with secondary budget and reveal-order results, including an answer-position reversal. The manuscript explicitly restricts interpretation to finite pools and recorded stochastic traces and rejects component-level causality, actual-cost equivalence, and cross-bed generalization. However, all experimental records, implementations, registrations, schedules, mask draws, and evidence-ID crosswalks are missing, so only the formal framing and internal arithmetic can be checked.
strongest_verified_contribution: The strongest independently checkable contribution is the precise finite-pool, realized-trace estimand and the disciplined interpretation boundary. The printed summaries are arithmetically coherent—for example, (106-54)/400=13.0 percentage points and the corresponding exact two-sided McNemar p-value is 4.80e-5—but this verifies transcription consistency, not the underlying experiment.
strengths: Equation 1 clearly conditions the contrast on the named finite pool and recorded stochastic realization, and the paper consistently avoids claiming a population, seed-family, or component-level effect.
The reported effects and raw exact McNemar tests are internally consistent with the printed n and b/c counts across Tables 3, 5, and 6.
The position-specific Table 6 counts sum exactly to the aggregate 145/99 discordance counts, and the construction strata do likewise.
The endpoint hierarchy responsibly distinguishes the sole source-designated primary result from post-selected sensitivities and secondary analyses.
The paper correctly limits forward-call equality to a manuscript accounting proxy and does not equate it with FLOPs, latency, memory, energy, or causal isolation.
The eight-page PDF is anonymous, legible, within the stated page limit, and contains an explicit author AI-assistance disclosure.
questions: What probability or randomization model is intended to give the reported confidence intervals and p-values meaning when the stated target is the fixed quantity Delta(P,omega)?
Can the authors provide an anonymous, hash-addressed E10-E14 crosswalk with per-item records, prompts, choice sets, scorer traces, and analysis code sufficient to reproduce every table?
Why is anti_inject part of the advertised five-arm audit but absent from the results and reviewer-safe experiment registry?
What exactly is the mc_uniform partial-mask loss—sum or mean—and how are subsets, replacement, confidence ties, tokenization, and the separate selection/scoring calls defined?

How stable are the primary and reveal-order contrasts across independently serialized mask streams and reveal schedules, and how much of the answer-position reversal is attributable to score ties and first-index tie breaking?

issues.location: PDF p. 2, Section 3, Bed and evidence boundary; p. 3, Section 4; p. 5, Section 6; pp. 7-8, Appendix D, Tables 9-10; reviewer-safe experiment registry A14-X1 and A14-X2
issues.observed_evidence: The manuscript and registry explicitly state that E10-E14, the ID crosswalk, item-level outputs, sampling frames, prompts, choice construction, model/tokenizer revisions, scorer traces, schedules, mask draws, statistical code, and registrations are absent. All supplied snapshot-file hashes match MANIFEST.json, so this is not a snapshot-integrity defect; the scientific evidence itself is missing.
issues.why_it_matters: Pool membership, disjointness, pairing, candidate validity, scores, predictions, b/c counts, and inferential summaries cannot be checked. This does not demonstrate that the numbers are false, but it leaves every empirical headline claim as an unauditable transcription from an unavailable source manuscript.
issues.required_fix: Supply a complete anonymous experimental bundle containing hashed sampling-frame identifiers, exact prompts and choices, model/tokenizer/environment revisions, implementations and configurations, serialized stochastic traces, per-candidate scores and predictions, per-item paired records, statistical code, registrations, and an E10-E14 crosswalk.
issues.verification_test: Validate all bundle hashes; reconstruct every choice and tokenization input; replay each arm; compare per-candidate scores and predictions; then independently recompute accuracies, discordance tables, effects, intervals, exact tests, strata, and every manuscript table. All reported values and pool-overlap claims must match within declared numerical tolerances.
issues.evidence_needed: Resolvable E10-E14 artifacts, raw paired records, complete method inputs, execution traces, analysis code, and an independently generated reproduction report.

issues.location: PDF p. 3, Equation 1 and the finite-pool estimand discussion; pp. 3-6, Tables 3-6; p. 7, Appendix C, Uncertainty and multiplicity
issues.observed_evidence: Equation 1 defines a descriptive quantity for fixed P and fixed omega and explicitly rejects population or scorer-randomness coverage. The paper nevertheless foregrounds 95% intervals, exact McNemar p-values, and a cross-pool z-test without specifying a sampling, assignment, or exchangeability model. The single-draw and 128-draw interval half-widths numerically equal 1.96*sqrt(b+c)/n, a null-standard-error construction whose effect-interval interpretation is not justified.
issues.why_it_matters: Once P and omega are conditioned upon, the stated contrast has no remaining sampling uncertainty. McNemar and bootstrap inference requires an additional stochastic target and assumptions. Without them, the p-values and 95% labels do not quantify uncertainty for the declared estimand and may materially overstate evidential strength.
issues.required_fix: Choose one coherent target. For a strictly descriptive finite-pool paper, remove inferential p-values and confidence-coverage language and report exact effects and discordance counts. Alternatively, define a source-population or stochastic-policy estimand, state item and trace sampling assumptions, and use an analysis that incorporates both item and scorer-realization variability.
issues.verification_test: For a descriptive revision, verify that no inferential interpretation remains and that every effect is exactly reconstructible from paired counts. For an inferential revision, preregister the probability model and estimator, reproduce the analysis from item/seed-level records, and demonstrate calibrated Type-I error or interval coverage under the stated design.
issues.evidence_needed: A declared sampling/randomization model, sampling-frame documentation, item-level paired outcomes, repeated mask streams and reveal schedules where relevant, and executable interval/test code.

issues.location: PDF p. 1, Evidence notation; p. 2, Table 1 and Table 2; p. 3, finite-pool testing paragraph; pp. 3-4, Table 3; p. 7, Appendix C
issues.observed_evidence: Preregistered and sole-primary status are only source-manuscript labels; the registration object and timing evidence are absent. The complete ten-test Holm family and adjusted values are also absent. Moreover, anti_inject is defined as the fifth arm, but no anti_inject outcome is reported despite the claimed five-arm audit.
issues.why_it_matters: The reader cannot establish whether the highlighted endpoint preceded outcome inspection, whether the displayed raw p-value belongs to the declared confirmatory family, or whether omitted arm results alter the audit's interpretation. This creates unresolved selection and multiplicity risk even though the displayed raw primary p-value is arithmetically correct.
issues.required_fix: Provide the timestamped registration and complete hypothesis ledger, report all five arm accuracies and all prespecified comparisons with discordance counts and adjusted values, and document deviations. If timing evidence cannot be recovered, remove preregistered/confirmatory language and present the analyses as exploratory.
issues.verification_test: Confirm that a content-hashed registration predates outcome access; regenerate all ten pairwise results and Holm adjustments from the complete paired record; verify that endpoint roles and anti_inject reporting match the registration and manuscript.
issues.evidence_needed: Machine-readable registration with timestamp provenance, full five-arm predictions, complete hypothesis family, adjustment code, and all raw and adjusted statistics.

issues.location: PDF pp. 2-3, Section 3, Five scoring arms and Table 2; p. 7, Appendix C, Protocol tuple and Table 7; reviewer-safe method provenance A14-M1 and A14-M4
issues.observed_evidence: The paper names reveal schedules and aggregate loss operations but omits exact prompts, model/tokenizer revisions, loss reduction conventions, subset sampling/replacement rules, confidence-tie resolution, random-generator semantics, batching, and the implementation responsible for the asserted L selection plus L scoring calls. The provenance table says both implementation and instrumented call traces were not located.
issues.why_it_matters: These choices can change scores, predictions, determinism, and invocation counts. In particular, the 2L/2L sensitivity depends on the exact call ledger. The paper properly avoids equating calls with actual resource cost, but even equality of its narrower invocation proxy remains unverifiable.
issues.required_fix: Give executable pseudocode or code for every arm, exact formulas and loss reductions, prompt/tokenization specifications, all tie and randomization rules, and instrumented per-candidate traces separating selection and scoring calls.
issues.verification_test: On fixed toy inputs and candidates spanning the reported lengths, log every model input, mask, revealed position, token loss, tie decision, score, and call. Confirm total calls of L or 2L as claimed and require an independent implementation to reproduce the same scores and choices from the serialized traces.
issues.evidence_needed: Scorer code, configuration files, prompt bytes, model/tokenizer hashes, deterministic tie rules, serialized traces, and call instrumentation.

issues.location: PDF p. 5, References entry for Nie et al. 2025; p. 8, Appendix E; included citation_lock.json entry nie2025llada
issues.observed_evidence: The PDF identifies Large Language Diffusion Models as an ICML 2025 paper, while the supplied citation lock identifies the same title as a NeurIPS 2025 proceedings paper. Appendix E nevertheless states that the lock verifies primary-source metadata.
issues.why_it_matters: The package is internally inconsistent about the venue of a central model citation, so its claimed metadata verification is not presently reliable. Under the no-internet review constraint, I cannot determine which venue entry is correct.
issues.required_fix: Check the authoritative primary record and make the bibliography, citation lock, and Appendix E claim agree; include a stable proceedings identifier or DOI where available.
issues.verification_test: Compare title, author list, year, venue, and persistent identifier against the authoritative proceedings record, then confirm exact agreement between the corrected lock and bibliography.
issues.evidence_needed: Authoritative proceedings metadata and a corrected, hash-locked bibliography/citation record.

ethics_concerns: No human-subject, privacy, deployment-safety, or other application-specific ethics concern is apparent. Missing provenance is treated as a scientific-integrity and soundness problem, not as evidence of misconduct.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by a fresh, isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control. It remained read-only, and all paper-specific judgments used only the frozen snapshot, without internet, parent-directory, repository-history, prior-review, author-note, revision-record, or target-score access.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: A hash-validated anonymous E10-E14 bundle followed by independent replay and exact reproduction of every reported result.
A valid pre-outcome registration and complete five-arm multiplicity ledger, or an honest exploratory reframing if timing cannot be established.
A coherent inferential target with calibrated item- and scorer-level uncertainty, supported by independently serialized mask streams and reveal schedules.
Complete operational scorer definitions and instrumented traces confirming predictions and the L/2L call accounting.
Replicated protocol effects across additional checkpoints, tasks, and independently constructed choice pools; this would be needed to move beyond a narrow borderline contribution.
evidence_that_would_lower_score: Recomputation that materially changes any headline effect, discordance count, direction, or exact test.
Evidence of duplicated, overlapping, invalid, or label-leaking choice construction in the n=400 or n=819 pools.
Registration timestamps or ledgers showing that the sole-primary endpoint was selected after outcome inspection.
Independent mask-stream or schedule evaluations showing unstable signs or that the reported realization is atypical.
Tie-robust analysis showing that the fixed-order position reversal is primarily an artifact of first-index tie breaking.
Instrumented traces showing that the asserted 2L/2L invocation match is incorrect.
review_limitations: The underlying experiments could not be verified because all central records and implementations are absent; criticisms explicitly distinguish this cannot_verify status from demonstrated numerical error.
Internet access was prohibited, so citation support was assessed only from the included partial lock; the observed LLaDA venue contradiction could not be externally adjudicated.
All eight PDF pages and every reviewer-safe file listed in MANIFEST.json were inspected, and the listed file hashes were verified.
